nodes.statement: The rigidity of the solution space is determined by the architectural composition (width-to-depth ratio) of the network; wider shallow networks exhibit lower dimensional solution manifolds compared to narrow deep ones for the same constraint count w.

The transition from rigid to fat solution spaces is governed by an effective "training temperature" (learning rate/noise); higher effective temperature increases the dimensionality of the reachable solution family, delaying the onset of rigidity as w increases.

The solution space topology exhibits a phase transition in its geometric structure (connectivity of minima) at a critical sample size w_c, where isolated rigid solutions merge into a continuous fat manifold.

The solution space rigidity is dominated by the network's architectural composition (width-to-depth ratio). Specifically, a "wide-shallow" composition yields a lower-dimensional solution space (rigid) compared to "narrow-deep" compositions for the same constraint count w, due to the limited expressivity of depth in small networks.

The transition from rigid to fat solution spaces is governed by an effective "training temperature" (learning rate schedule and noise injection). Higher effective temperature allows the optimizer to explore a broader manifold (fat), while lower temperature converges to isolated points (rigid).

The solution space exhibits a phase transition in its topological structure at a critical sample size w_c. Below w_c, the manifold is continuous (fat); above w_c, it collapses to isolated points (rigid), detectable via the connectivity of minima in the loss landscape.
解空间刚性主要由网络的架构组成（宽深比）主导：在固定约束数 w 下，宽浅型网络因参数冗余度高易形成连续解族（胖），而窄深型网络因表达力受限更易收敛至孤立点（刚）。
解空间从胖到刚的过渡受热力学类比参数“训练温度”（学习率调度与噪声注入）控制：高温允许 optimizer 探索更大流形（胖），低温冻结至局部极小（刚），导致 N_c(w) 随温度降低而减小。
解空间拓扑结构在临界样本数 w_c 处发生相变：w < w_c 时解流形连通（胖），w > w_c 时流形断裂为孤立点（刚），N_c(w) 的突变趋势是此拓扑相变的直接探针。

nodes.statement: 新假设：前馈网络的解空间刚性可通过“输出函数对输入扰动的Lipschitz常数敏感性”作为替代探针——在固定样本数w下，测量最小零违规宽度网络输出的Lipschitz常数的分布方差，若方差随w单调递减且趋近于0，则支持刚性；若方差保持高位或震荡，则支持胖。
通过固定网络容量并系统性增加约束数量 $w$，观察留出误差 plateau 的同时测量最小零违规宽度网络输出函数对输入扰动的 Lipschitz 常数方差，若两者均趋于稳定（误差 plateau 且方差趋近于 0），则强支持解空间刚性；若误差 plateau 但方差仍高或震荡，则支持胖解空间。
